It's been almost a year since we released the very first EA version. Time really flies.
This week, we have some big news to announce.

Take a look!


Main Contents
1. Skin DLC 

Some of you might notice that our store page is rather crowded.

We really appreciate all your supports and any opinions to improve 3MH.

But announcing the full release doesn't mean the end of further updates.
We'll keep refining any numbers, graphics, and sounds as possible.

You can download it for free, but only 3 heroes(Sorcerer, Warrior, Hunter) will be unlocked.

We'll let you know furthermore details about the mobile version after it's in the store!

notes.title: [Weekly Update 46] 2 Golem Boss Monsters
notes.notes:
Hi, All!
It's getting colder here in South Korea. Hope you guys doing well.ːsteamhappyː

This week, we've added 2 new golem boss monsters, 'Brassica' and 'Olera'.

Main Contents
1. New Golem Boss Monsters

Brassica

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156053/c3012be6309da73b4f651eece4b8a05b3bfecd7e.gif

Brassica is a solid monster who protects himself by surrounding wooden fences. 
He generates 2 types of fences. One recovers the house's durability and the other deals damage to the house. So it seems that he's kinda helping to repair our house.

But when Brassica uses mana skill, he changes all fences into the latter ones.
So when you deal with Brassica, it's important to attack him only and not to destroy the offensive fences.


Olera

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156053/e2968596bc7fe3227f2126c95b09b719eb575ec2.gif

Olera is an ice golem who summon an ice ball monster and hinders you from using cards.
He uses a blizzard card as a basic attack and summons an ice ball monster that ignores the characters in the allied field and moves directly to the house.

Olera's special power is to make players hard to use cards.
When Olera is in the field, the player's hand freezes for 3 seconds after playing a card.
Freezing time is displayed below the screen.


In addition to this update, we have renewed the store page of newly added languages like Japanese, Chinese, Russian, French, and German. Hope many other players can meet 3MH.

Thanks a lot!

Hi, all! ːsteamhappyː

Main Contents
1. New Ghost Boss Monsters

Peperon

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156053/a848b24af5d58e929e37fb62cd53c05b7aed334e.gif

Peperon is grim-reaper wearing a red robe and generates 'not selectable tiles' on the enemy field.
He moves to the ally's tile when he attacks, so that's the time to use any cards on him.

Peperon's mana skill is to using instant kill and summons a random ghost monster.
So it'll be really picky to maintain the ally field and to deal with the boss at the same time.


Jalapa

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156053/a3fe1a0cb8ffc80551fca909aa988fee1116125e.gif

Jalapa is a big green ghost with absorbing damage ability.
He turns into the absorbing mode and accumulates taken damages.
(Taken damages are counted and displayed on his clock)

When he turns back to the normal mode, he throws a projectile that deals the same damage he has taken while absorbing mode.

He also uses Haste buff when using mana skill so it can be difficult to deal with him after boss raging.


Like other boss monsters, the SFXs and various effects to make them look great will be added soon.
Until then, please inform us of any bugs or opinions in our 3MH Discord Channel!

Main Contents

Gua

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156053/8870a9b60e3b16482ef77399776b0fe127225df0.gif

Gua is an elder shaman who summons totems and derives power from them.
Gua casts a spell according to the remaining totem on the field.
Following is the list of totems Gua summons.

 Gua uses 'Pillar of fire' when 'Pillar of Fire Totem' is on the field. 
 Gua uses 'Thunderbolt' when 'Thunderbolt Totem' is on the field.
 Gua uses 'Recovery' himself when 'Recovery Totem' is on the field.

As a mana skill, Gua summon destroyed totems.
So make sure to keep destroy Gua's totem to suppress Gua's power!



Maracu

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156053/a8c7e41d88ebe4578434f32abfd7ab9c96ee9c35.gif

Maracu is a secret weapon of the Goblin army.
It throws a big harpoon-like arrow in the middle row of the allied field.
Also, it gathers units and heroes of the upper and lower row to the middle row.

If Maracu gets negative states like burn, frost, poisoning and instant kill,
those states are applied on the Maracu's arrow.
(You can identify which states are applied by the flags hung of the side of Maracu)

notes.title: [Weekly Update 43] New Boss Monsters
notes.notes:
Hi, all! ːsteamhappyː
We thought overall gameplay is rather stabilized.
So we tried to update some more in-game content, the new boss monsters.

Main Contents
1. New Boss Monsters

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156053/f006675446a45cc49e42485bc159288b34eb5e8b.png

We think one of the key features in 3MH is repeatability.
So we decided to update more boss monsters to make diverse play experiences.

Our update plan is to add 2 boss monsters for each faction.
So in conclusion, there'll be 12 new boss monsters will be added.

We've focused on making bosses appear to be impressive looking and performing actions that we've not made yet. So we hope upcoming boss monsters make your play more interesting. 

In this week, our new Slime boss monster, Strawbe and Mosca is joined the demon army.

Strawbe

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156053/ca45d57beb0ffe66dc163e6622bff27dad36c74e.gif

Strawbe, actually Strawbes are twins slime monsters that jump into an allied field and deal damage.
They also apply stun state, so can be a little bit hard to deal with.

Furthermore, they use mana skill to equalize HP to the higher one.
So make sure you deal damage evenly!


Mosca

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156053/83143d7adad97e113059fbb0960121d4c7549349.gif

Mosca is toxic slime deals damage directly to the house.
And also it applies poisoning state to entire allies in the field.

But once poisoned ally down, the debuff turn back to Mosca.
Also, when Mosca dies, it deactivates all poisoning state of allies.

So you'd better find a way to keep the house safe and handle it fast.


Stay tuned on upcoming boss monsters and feel free to give us any feedback or opinions about them to our Discord channel!

 You may not activate the altars. But it deals damage to the house if it's not activated for 10 seconds.


Quests
Now you can do a quest on the reward selection page with a hero.
Each quest includes a mini-game or trading and it depends on the hero who you interact with. 
Some quests give you the opportunity to upgrade the card for a special reward!

Card Upgrade System
'Card upgrade system' gives you a chance to upgrade cards.
Clear any quests and add keywords that adding debuff to the enemies, decreasing card cost to your card!


Happy new year and please stay tuned for 3 Minute Heroes! ːsteamhappyː
